reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and findWeekdayOccurrence helpers instead of adding parallel holiday logic, and every weekend site in the tree now uses them.

duplication.why: A single isNonWorkingDay predicate replaces the scattered d.isWeekend checks; the pre-existing daily-skip vs. shift dispatch in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange/getNextDate is still repeated, but the diff adds no new copy.

placement.why: The predicate and the shift live in shared/schedules.ts; the type gains the optional field in models/schedule.ts and parseRecurDate carries it, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Touches only the type, the recur parser, the shared date helpers and their callers.

maintainability.why: One definition of a non-working day is easy to own, though holidays is threaded by hand through every call and the search margins grow by holidays.length as a heuristic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: all weekend checks in app.ts and schedule-template.ts now go through isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend

disguised_duplication.where: none; the inline isWeekend checks were replaced by the shared predicate

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, findWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template
